cover_family_selection_rationale: Лица на сайте только живые. Обложка блога не имеет права на сгенерированного человека, поэтому серия строится на макроматериале костюма: пайетка, мех, пуговица, микрофон.
global_prompt_prefix: Macro photograph, 16:9, of a single New Year costume material, no people, no faces, no beard, no hands, no children, no cartoon. Dark banquet background #141218, warm practical light from the upper left, shallow depth of field. Brand colors only as they exist in the object: cranberry sequin #6E1A28, ivory fur #F7F1E8, gold thread #8A6232, a small edge of classic blue #1E4F86 if the scene asks for embroidery.
global_prompt_suffix: Thumbnail-safe, subject near center, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no snowflake overlay, no confetti storm, no 3D character, no illustration. Same series lighting every time.
global_negative_prompt: people, face, eyes, beard, Santa, Snow Maiden, child, hands, emoji, text, letters, watermark, cartoon snow, snowflakes covering frame, clay render, mascot, champagne glasses, five costumes, neon

composition_lock.layout_description: Один материал по центру, около 60% кадра, фон уходит в ночь зала

informational.scene_bias: one calm material, more ivory fur than red

how_to.scene_bias: microphone mesh or staff wood, still no hands

case.scene_bias: sequin and fur together, still no people

local.scene_bias: same macro, a hint of warm hall bokeh, no skyline, no landmark that needs a fake sign

style_anchor.prompt_used: Use global_prompt_prefix plus scene: extreme close-up of red sequin next to white fur and one gold button, no people.
